tagline: Trusted Heating, Cooling & Furnace Service in Brillion, WI
ownerStory: Backed by over 23 years serving Brillion, Kaukauna, Kimberly, and the Fox Valley, Born Heating & Cooling delivers dependable furnace repairs, high-efficiency HVAC replacements, air conditioning service, and custom sheet-metal ductwork built for harsh Wisconsin winters and humid summers.

services.name: Furnace & Boiler Repair & Replacements
services.desc: Fast diagnostics, heat-exchanger safety inspections, and high-AFUE gas furnace installations across Brillion, Kaukauna, and Northeast Wisconsin—including flooded utility-room replacements.

services.name: Central A/C & Heat Pump Installation
services.desc: Quiet, properly sized high-SEER2 central air conditioners and cold-climate heat pumps installed on level concrete pads with precision refrigerant charging and clean line-set insulation.

services.name: Custom Ductwork, Air Quality & Tune-Ups
services.desc: Sealed galvanized sheet-metal trunk lines, balanced airflow modifications, humidifiers, and seasonal tune-ups to keep utility bills low and prevent mid-season breakdowns.
